title: Kroenen — Sideshow Life-Size Mask (2004)
description: A life-size Kroenen mask from Sideshow, dated 2004 in the collection caption. The owner records a limited edition of 1,500; the item is presented as a collectible mask rather than a screen-used prop.

title: B.P.R.D. — Fez-o-rama Fez No. 50/50
description: A B.P.R.D. fez from Fez-o-rama. The owner identifies the museum’s example as number 50 in an edition of 50.

title: Tooth Fairy Chewing a Molar — Victor Marin Sculpture
description: A life-size Tooth Fairy sculpture titled Tooth Fairy Chewing a Molar. The original caption credits Victor Marin with the sculpture and Daniel Martínez with its paint finish.

title: Hellboy Cult Vinyl — Planet Replicas Figure
description: The standard Hellboy Cult Vinyl figure from Planet Replicas, retained separately from the gold variant documented elsewhere in the collection.

title: Hellboy — Toy2R Eight-Inch Qee Collection
description: A grouped collection of eight-inch Hellboy Qee figures from Toy2R. The original caption describes the set as complete when photographed.

title: Hellboy — Diamond Select Motion Picture Beanie Set (2004)
description: A grouped set of Diamond Select Hellboy Motion Picture Beanies, dated 2004 in the original caption. The owner identifies limited-edition Hellboy, regular Hellboy, Abe Sapien and Samael as the four characters in the display.
